e60148caca02778ba8d5.text: material viewed will help any student develop his/her skills in checking the veracity and authenticity of a certain thing. If you will try to determine and examine the relevance and truthfulness of the ideas presented in any form of literature, you need to analyze, evaluate, assess, and review.

34cfedaa29c9cade0a18.text: Through this module, your ability to examine things that are very relevant and

1043648fc918d9ef5d12.text: genuine will be developed. You will also learn how to fulfill your dreams and discard those unnecessary things that might be the hindrance of your plans and dreams in life.

7f13955d86f03713821c.text: After dealing with this module, you should be able to obtain the following:

169a5fba5bb38b750b1e.text: identify fact and opinion; evaluate the relevance and truthfulness of the ideas presented in any form of literature; note details from the literary work presented; give comprehensive details from the data or object presented; and understand the ideas presented in any form of literary work.

b77f6c1b729a0588ddb4.text: exist as you move forward and fulfill your dreams in life. As you journey and continue to seek those necessary and relevant things in your life in this changing world, you may encounter several challenges. Yet, these challenges will not pull you down nor make your life miserable for you already know how to face those. These challenges will serve as the yardstick of your personality. Using the skills that you will be learning in this module, you will be able to grasp more about what life could offer.

9e867a51cff0ee3f5776.text: To determine the relevance and truthfulness of an idea presented especially from the media, we assume that everything is true. In this lesson, determining the relevance and truthfulness needs to be scrutinized and examined. Here are some of the basic aspects to consider in identifying relevance and truth of the ideas presented from the material viewed; (a) fallacy, (b) fact, (c) opinion, and (bias)

5c16ed390cc23441d570.text: a. Fallacy - it is an idea which is believed to be true but it is really false due to incorrect information or reasoning. b. Fact - is an idea which is true and can be verified factually or proven.

21384d28fe46b9e70dbc.text: c. Opinion - is an idea or statement which only comes from someone’s feelings and cannot be proven. d. Bias – it is an idea that leads to poor judgment and poor decision making towards a certain thing for it could be positive one in favor of a certain person and negative for the other one.
